full_text_zh:
[P1] 上海美术电影制片厂出品·咿啦看书改编
大闹天宫（一）
如意金箍棒

[P2] 在遥远的东海边有一座花果山，花果山的瀑布后面有一个水帘洞，洞里住着一位美猴王——孙悟空。孙悟空带领着猴子们在花果山无忧无虑地生活着，就这样过了好多年。

[P3] 有一天，正当猴子们悠闲自在地玩耍时，突然有人大喊一声：“大王驾到！”所有的猴子都兴奋地朝水帘洞洞口跑过去。

[P4] 孙悟空吩咐道：“孩儿们，操练起来！”猴子们拿着兵器对打起来。孙悟空看得手痒痒，大喊一声：“拿俺老孙的大环刀来！”孙悟空把大刀舞成了影子，赢得了猴子们的阵阵喝彩。

[P5] 这时，一位年长的猴子走到孙悟空跟前说：“不知大王海里可能去得？”“俺老孙上天入地，无所不能，哪儿有去不得的地方！”孙悟空自豪地说。

[P6] 去往龙宫的途中，孙悟空遇到了龟虾二将。龟将军打不过孙悟空，只得把他带到了龙宫门口，而虾将军则赶紧回去禀报东海龙王了。

[P7] 东海龙王本来不想多事，可孙悟空已经来到了大殿上，笑着说：“老邻居，老邻居，俺老孙就住在花果山上，只因手中缺少趁手的兵器，特地来向您借一件使使。”

[P8] 孙悟空接过虾将军费力扛过来的枪，随手一折枪就弯了，孙悟空嘻嘻笑着说：“这算什么兵器！”

[P9] 老龙王一看糊弄不住孙悟空，就命人把三千六百斤的大环刀拿来给他。孙悟空掂了掂大环刀说：“轻，太轻！”说完就把刀扔在了地上。

[P10] 老龙王觉得有点没面子，说：“要更重的？有！”于是，他又让手下把重七千两百斤的方天戟抬出来。龟将军们全部出动，一个个累得气喘吁吁，才把方天戟抬到了孙悟空面前。

[P11] 没想到，孙悟空随手接过方天戟就舞了起来，看得龙王目瞪口呆。随后，孙悟空一把将方天戟插在地上，不满意地说：“还是轻了！你这偌大的龙宫，难道连件趁手的兵器都拿不出来吗？”

[P12] 老龙王正要争辩，龟丞相给他出了个主意：“龙宫的后院里有一根千年玄铁，怕是那猴头也拿不动它，到时候他自讨没趣，自然就会回去了……”老龙王心中暗喜，就带着孙悟空往后院走去。

[P13] 到了后院，老龙王指着一根锈迹斑斑的大柱子说：“大仙，请看！那是禹王治水时留下的宝物——定海神针。大仙要是拿得动，就送给大仙。”

[P14] 孙悟空越看越喜欢，止不住地赞叹：“好宝贝，好宝贝！”
可是这么大的定海神针怎么能当兵器呢？孙悟空嘴里念叨着：
“可惜太粗了，细一点儿就好了。”没想到这神针仿佛听懂了
他说的话似的，真的变细了些。

[P15] 待一切恢复平静，孙悟空拿起定海神针仔细一看，上面有一行字：
如意金箍棒，重三万六千斤。孙悟空喜欢得不得了，接连念了几句“小小小”，金箍棒变得大小刚好，果然是如意金箍棒呀，这次总算是称了孙悟空的心意。

[P16] 孙悟空拿着金箍棒舞动如风，金箍棒也仿佛有了生命一样，一人一棒竟然有相见恨晚的感觉。

[P17] 孙悟空向老龙王连连道谢，就要带走金箍棒。想不到龙王居然反悔了，他说：“这是我镇海之宝，你不能拿走！”
“只要我拿得动，你就送给我。难道你说了不算吗？”孙悟空
full_text_en:
[P1] Produced by Shanghai Animation Film Studio · Adapted by Yila Reading
The Monkey King's Rebellion in Heaven (Part 1)
Ruyi Jingu Bang

[P2] In the distant eastern sea, there is a Flower Fruit Mountain. Behind the waterfall on the mountain lies a Water Curtain Cave, where lives a beautiful monkey king—Sun Wukong. Sun Wukong leads the monkeys in living carefree lives on Flower Fruit Mountain, and in this way, many years have passed.

[P3] One day, as the monkeys were playing leisurely, suddenly someone shouted, "The King has arrived!" All the monkeys excitedly ran towards the entrance of the Water Curtain Cave.

[P4] Sun Wukong instructed, "Children, let's practice!" The monkeys began fighting with their weapons. Sun Wukong, feeling his hands itch, shouted, "Bring me my big ring blade!" He swung the blade so fast it became a blur, earning cheers from the monkeys.

[P5] At this moment, an elderly monkey approached Sun Wukong and said, "Your Majesty, could you possibly go into the sea?" "I, Old Sun, can go anywhere—up to heaven, down to earth. There's no place I can't go!" Sun Wukong said proudly.

[P6] On his way to the Dragon Palace, Sun Wukong encountered the turtle and shrimp generals. The turtle general, unable to defeat Sun Wukong, had no choice but to bring him to the entrance of the Dragon Palace, while the shrimp general hurried back to report to the Dragon King of the Eastern Sea.

[P7] The East Sea Dragon King didn't want to cause trouble, but Sun Wukong had already arrived in the main hall. He smiled and said, "Old neighbor, old neighbor, I, Old Sun, live on Flower-Fruit Mountain. I've come specially to borrow a weapon that suits my hand, since I lack one."

[P8] Sun Wukong took the spear that the shrimp general had struggled to carry, snapped it with a flick of his wrist, and bent it. Sun Wukong laughed and said, "What kind of weapon is this!"

[P9] The Old Dragon King, seeing he couldn't fool Sun Wukong, ordered someone to bring him the great ring-blade weighing three thousand six hundred jin. Sun Wukong hefted the blade and said, "Light, too light!" Then he threw the blade to the ground.

[P10] The old Dragon King felt a bit embarrassed and said, “Want something heavier? We’ve got it!” So, he ordered his subordinates to bring out the Fangtian Jǐ, weighing seven thousand and two hundred jin. The turtle generals all mobilized, panting heavily, and finally managed to carry the Fangtian Jǐ to Sun Wukong.

[P11] Unexpectedly, Sun Wukong took the Fangtian Jie and began to wield it skillfully, leaving the Dragon King stunned. Then, Sun Wukong thrust the Fangtian Jie into the ground and complained, "Still too light! With such a vast Dragon Palace, can't you even produce a weapon that suits me?"

[P12] The old Dragon King was about to argue, but the Turtle Minister gave him an idea: "In the back courtyard of the Dragon Palace, there is a piece of thousand-year-old mystical iron. Even that monkey probably can't lift it. When he finds himself in an embarrassing situation, he'll naturally go back..." The old Dragon King was secretly delighted and led Sun Wukong to the back courtyard.

[P13] In the back courtyard, the old Dragon King pointed at a large, rust-covered pillar and said, "Great Immortal, look! This is the treasure left behind by Yu the Great when he tamed the floods—the Pillar of the Sea. If you can lift it, I will give it to you."

[P14] Sun Wukong liked it more and more, exclaiming uncontrollably: "What a treasure, what a treasure!"
But how could such a huge Sea-Stabilizing Needle be used as a weapon? Sun Wukong muttered to himself:
"Too thick, if only it were a bit thinner." Unexpectedly, the magic needle seemed to understand
what he said, and really became a bit thinner.

[P15] After everything calmed down, Sun Wukong picked up the Divine Sea-Settling Staff and examined it closely. There was a line of writing on it: 'Ruyi Jingu Bang, weighing 36,000 jin.' Sun Wukong was overjoyed. He chanted 'small, small, small' several times, and the staff instantly shrank to the perfect size. Indeed, it was the Ruyi Jingu Bang! This time, it finally suited Sun Wukong's wishes.

[P16] Sun Wukong swung the Golden-Hooped Rod with the speed of the wind; the rod seemed to come alive. The monkey and his staff felt as if they had met too late.

[P17] Sun Wukong thanked the Old Dragon King repeatedly and was about to take away the Golden Cudgel. Unexpectedly, the Dragon King regretted it and said, "This is my treasure that calms the sea; you cannot take it away!"
"As long as I can lift it, you must give it to me. Don't you mean what you said?" Sun Wukong
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《大闹天宫（一）》的封面，标题为“如意金箍棒”，标明由上海美术电影制片厂出品、咿啦看书改编，背景为云海与天宫景象。
[P2] 本页描绘了花果山的景象，猴子们在树上和果园中嬉戏，文字介绍了美猴王孙悟空带领群猴在花果山无忧无虑地生活多年。
[P3] 本页描绘了猴子们听到‘大王驾到’后，兴奋地朝水帘洞洞口跑去的场景，画面中有猴子敲鼓、吹号、举矛列队迎接。
[P4] 孙悟空带领猴子们操练武艺，他舞动大环刀，赢得群猴阵阵喝彩。
[P5] 一位年长的猴子询问孙悟空能否下海，孙悟空自信地表示自己无所不能，可去任何地方。
[P6] 孙悟空在前往龙宫的途中遇到龟虾二将，龟将军不敌孙悟空，将其带到龙宫门口，虾将军则返回禀报东海龙王。
[P7] 孙悟空来到东海龙宫大殿，向东海龙王借一件趁手的兵器，龙王正坐在宝座上，周围有虾兵蟹将守卫。
[P8] 孙悟空在东海龙宫试用虾将军递来的兵器，随手一折便将其弯折，轻蔑地表示这不配做兵器。
[P9] 孙悟空试用龙王拿出的三千六百斤大环刀，觉得太轻，随手将其扔在地上。
[P10] 东海龙王为满足孙悟空的要求，命龟将军们抬出重达七千两百斤的方天戟，众人累得气喘吁吁才将其抬到孙悟空面前。
[P11] 孙悟空接过龙王命人抬来的方天戟，轻松舞动后仍觉太轻，将其插在地上，并质问龙王为何拿不出趁手的兵器。
[P12] 龟丞相向老龙王献计，提议用后院的千年玄铁来难住孙悟空，老龙王欣然同意并带孙悟空前往后院。
[P13] 老龙王带孙悟空来到后院，指着一根锈迹斑斑的大柱子，称其为禹王治水时留下的宝物——定海神针，并表示若孙悟空能拿动，便赠予他。
[P14] 孙悟空看到定海神针后非常喜欢，但觉得它太粗，不适合当兵器，于是念叨着希望它变细，神针竟真的随之变细了。
[P15] 孙悟空拿起定海神针，发现上面刻有‘如意金箍棒，重三万六千斤’，他念动口诀使其变小，最终得到称心如意的兵器。
[P16] 孙悟空挥舞着新得到的金箍棒，动作如风，仿佛与兵器心意相通，产生了相见恨晚的感觉。
[P17] 孙悟空拿到金箍棒后准备离开，东海龙王反悔并试图阻止，孙悟空质问龙王是否说话不算数。
